verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is documented as a serverless framework that runs backend code in response to HTTPS requests, Admin SDK calls, background events and Cloud Scheduler jobs. The code deploys with one CLI command and scales automatically, with local emulator support for testing. Community users mention Functions as part of the offering but give no hands-on detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of client-SDK callable functions (only the Admin SDK is named), and independent hands-on corroboration of HTTP/SDK invocation and deployment.
